scope: PR Review: four L product/evidence/committed/execution modules and four corresponding tests; read-only package/main tree

P2.title: Title affects news sentiment without capture hash binding
P2.symptom: Changing title alone from negative to positive leaves body contentSha256 admitted but flips NewsFacts sentiment. Market inputHash and planHash remain unchanged; no separate full evidence version hash binds title.
P2.consequence: Untrusted altered metadata can change the displayed news interpretation under the same captured body identity.
P2.remedy: Bind all consumed source fields, especially title, to an immutable document/evidence version hash; keep price-plan hash independent.
P2.confirmedBy: Product review identified; independent news agent reproduced using real buildBrief

P2.title: Global body-hash dedupe loses cross-instrument coverage
P2.symptom: Two admitted documents with identical body but distinct valid ETF associations retain only first symbol. Reversing input order switches coverage.
P2.consequence: An ETF can incorrectly display no admissible news depending solely on input order.
P2.remedy: Deduplicate source/vote identity while preserving validated symbol associations and citation bindings.
P2.confirmedBy: Independent news agent red regression; reused shared evidence to avoid rerunning duplicate work

productExecutionFindings: No additional P1/P2 found in reviewed scope. Two evidence P2 are shared with news review, not duplicate new findings.
